common.tagline: Bringing back nostalgia, one digital letter at a time.

home.heroEyebrow: A digital postbox for handwritten feelings
home.heroTitle: Some things deserve more than a text message.
home.heroSubtitle: Write a letter the way you used to — pick a paper, a tune to go with it, and send it as a secret link, an SMS surprise, or a real envelope sealed with wax.
home.howItWorksTitle: From blank page to their doorstep
home.step1Body: Open the writing pad and start typing under any nickname you like. No account, no pressure.
home.step2Body: Pick a paper texture and a background tune — rain, an old gramophone, or a quiet piano.
home.step3Body: A quick phone verification keeps DakPion spam-free, without ever revealing your identity to the recipient.
home.step4Body: Share a private link yourself, send an SMS alert, or have it printed, sealed, and couriered for real.
home.pricingTeaserBody: Writing and sending a plain letter is always free. Pay only for the flourishes.

about.title: About DakPion
about.subtitle: Reviving the warmth, emotion, and patience of handwritten letters in the digital era.
about.storyP1: In a fast-paced world dominated by instant notifications and fleeting messages, DakPion was born from a desire to slow down and cherish words that truly matter.
about.storyP2: Inspired by the timeless nostalgia of the classic postman carrying envelopes sealed with wax and fragrant ink, we created a platform that bridges the physical and digital worlds.
about.val1Body: Every letter is written with deliberate care, designed with tactile parchment themes, atmospheric audio, and sealed envelopes.
about.val2Body: Your heartfelt letters and personal messages are kept strictly private and delivered only to their intended recipients.
about.val3Body: From instant digital secret links to physical letters delivered to doorsteps across Bangladesh, we make sure every word finds home.
about.techBody: DakPion is engineered and maintained by MSR Technologies, dedicated to building high-quality, impactful digital solutions for Bangladesh and beyond.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: Your letters, emotions, and personal privacy are our sacred commitment.
privacy.sec1Body: We collect necessary information to process and deliver your letters, including recipient names, delivery phone numbers, and physical postal addresses where applicable. Account registration requires verified phone contact to prevent spam and abuse.
privacy.sec2Body: The content of your letters is strictly private. For digital letters, only persons possessing the unique secret link can open and read the envelope. For physical deliveries, letters are printed and wax-sealed directly by authorized handlers following strict confidentiality protocols.
privacy.sec3Body: All financial transactions are securely processed via SSLCommerz payment gateway. DakPion does not store or process your credit card numbers, bank accounts, or MFS PIN numbers directly on our servers.
privacy.sec4Body: All communication is encrypted using industry-standard SSL/TLS protocols. We store minimal data and implement security safeguards to protect your personal information against unauthorized access.
privacy.sec5Body: If you have questions or concerns regarding our privacy practices, please contact our data protection team via support@dakpion.com.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.subtitle: Please read these terms carefully before using the DakPion platform.
terms.sec1Body: By accessing or using DakPion (developed by MSR Technologies), you agree to comply with and be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree with any part of these terms, please do not use our services.
terms.sec2Body: DakPion is a platform for personal expression and meaningful communication. You agree not to send letters containing hate speech, threats, harassment, defamatory statements, illegal material, or unsolicited commercial spam.
terms.sec3Body: Digital links are generated instantly. SMS Speed Post notifications are dispatched via telecom gateways. Physical letters are prepared and handed over to courier partners for domestic delivery within Bangladesh.
terms.sec4Body: Standard digital letters are free of charge. Premium themes, audio accompaniments, SMS alerts, and physical courier deliveries are priced as listed in BDT and processed securely via SSLCommerz.
terms.sec5Body: All logos, designs, typography, illustrations, and codebase of DakPion are the proprietary property of MSR Technologies and protected under applicable intellectual property laws.
terms.sec6Body: These terms shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of Bangladesh.
